blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint — Legend of the Verdant Sigil

## Source truth
The preserved source is a browser-native portrait top-down survival combat game. The player controls a single hero on a full-screen canvas using a virtual joystick, tap/light attack, hold/heavy attack, roll, keyboard fallbacks, and an inventory/armory overlay. Monsters spawn from screen edges, chase or vary pursuit behavior, collide with the player to deal damage, and die when sword arcs reduce their HP. Progress is tracked through hearts/HP, waves over time, kills, rupees, loot level, inventory relic counts, weapon unlocks, and a game-over/restart state.

## Protected mechanics
- Continuous joystick movement and keyboard/touch action semantics.
- Canvas update/render loop using time delta and resize-aware portrait scaling.
- Edge spawning, monster behavior families, HP/damage, collision contact, invulnerability, slash range checks, roll distance/cooldown, and game-over threshold.
- Score/progress semantics: kills, rupees, wave, loot level, item counts, weapon unlock thresholds, and heart-vessel HP gains.
- Inventory equip gating and blocked feedback for sealed weapons.

## Remix target
Reframe the same loop as a mythic Zelda-like overworld shrine defense: a green-clad sigil bearer cleanses shadow creatures, gathers Deku Seeds / Forest Keys / Sage Runes, unseals heroic arms, and survives moonlit shrine waves. This is a presentation, copy, media, and procedural-art transformation; mechanics remain the same.

## Safe transformation surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title/objective plaque, procedural hero/monster silhouettes, shrine background, tri-sigil/locked-door motifs, particles, popups, fonts, catalog audio/GIF accents, inventory labels, failure copy, and documentation artifacts.

## Runtime architecture
Canonical `index.html` is self-contained with inline CSS/JS plus approved catalog remote media. `index_old.html` is reference-only evidence.
